miranda: Cutting RC from main at commit 7f3a2b4. I created the candidate build: artifact: infra-redwood-rc-20260318-7f3a2b4
sanjay: Ack. What's the intended change window? I can request the ops pin once confirmed.
miranda: 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC prefer 2h window. No DB schema changes in this RC. Diff: https://git.company/repo/commit/7f3a2b4
sanjay: OK requesting pin. Pin to: infra-redwood-rc-20260318-7f3a2b4 @ops
ops-bot: @channel ops pin requested by sanjay for artifact infra-redwood-rc-20260318-7f3a2b4 on 2026-03-18 22:00-00:00 UTC. Approvers needed: infra-oncall, release-owner
amanda: Quick question: any canary traffic split? recommend 5% for 30m then 25% for 30m if stable.
leo: Also note we have a small KV cache migration planned next week; this RC does not touch it but watch cache warm-up. If latency spikes >200ms we should rollback.
deploy-bot: Build succeeded: infra-redwood-rc-20260318-7f3a2b4
deploy-bot: Smoke tests started (smoke-suite v2.1)
deploy-bot: Smoke tests passed (all green)
sanjay: Pin approved by infra-oncall (:thumbsup:). @miranda I'll submit the formal change window request and add rollback playbook to the ticket.
miranda: Thanks. Rollback playbook snippet:
```
# rollback steps
kubectl set image deployment/redwood-api api=redwood/api:stable-20260301
apply config rollback: rcfallback=true
monitor trace errors and latency for 10 min
```
amanda: I'll prepare the canary route and health-check thresholds and add to the runbook.
leo: Leaving a note: if model-serving pods show OOMs, scale down batch-size param and redeploy.
miranda: All right, merging RC branch to release stream now and will follow up when change window is created.
ops-bot: Change window created: 2026-03-18 22:00-00:00 UTC. Change ticket CHG-20260318-87
miranda: tagging release notes in the ticket: "RC candidate: infra improvements, perf tweak to batching, no schema changes"
sanjay: moving to post: deploy checklist next: canary, telemetry, full rollout schedule
miranda: good to close thread, will ping again at T-1h before cutover.
